MOD_Service_Robot_a455ee.name: Service_Robot

It also streams real-time video/audio feeds and chatlogs to the Remote Operator Frontend.

Role: sensing_input:env_sensor

MOD_Cloud_Services_641802.name: Cloud_Services
MOD_Cloud_Services_641802.function: The Cloud Services act as a central communication hub, mediating between the Service Robot and the Remote Operator Frontend. It receives pre-processed signals from the robot, processes them (e.g., using DialogFlow for intent recognition), and sends commands and updated skills back to the robot. It also receives commands and training data from the Remote Operator Frontend and sends intent failure prompts to it.
MOD_Cloud_Services_641802.source: Exploring Future Work – Co-Designing a Human-Robot Collaboration Environment for Service Domains
MOD_Cloud_Services_641802._embed_content:
Name: Cloud_Services
Role: infrastructure:communication
Function: The Cloud Services act as a central communication hub, mediating between the Service Robot and the Remote Operator Frontend. It receives pre-processed signals from the robot, processes them (e.g., using DialogFlow for intent recognition), and sends commands and updated skills back to the robot. It also receives commands and training data from the Remote Operator Frontend and sends intent failure prompts to it.
Input: Pre-processed signals from Service Robot; commands (Text-to-Speech, Motion, Animation), training data (intents, user expressions, responses) from Remote Operator Frontend.
Output: Commands (Navigation, Voice, Predefined Actions), updated skills to Service Robot; intent failure prompts to Remote Operator Frontend.

ART_bce1ce8d.full_code:
graph TD
    subgraph Designer
        A[Physical Model Creation] --> B(Physical Model)
        C[Voice/Text Input] --> Voice_Text_Input
        D[Select Style] --> Scheme_Style_Folder
        E[Refinement Input] --> Generated_Schemes_Display
    end

    subgraph ProtoDreamer System
        Image_Capture["Image Capture"] --> Detailed_Generation_Control
        Voice_Text_Input["Voice/Text Input"] --> Detailed_Generation_Control
        Scheme_Style_Folder["Scheme Style Folder"] --> Matrix_based_Generation

        subgraph Detailed_Generation_Control["Detailed Generation Control"]
            Region_Segmentation["Region Segmentation"]
            Morphological_Dilation["Morphological Dilation"]
            Sequential_Inpainting["Sequential Inpainting"]
            Region_Segmentation --> Morphological_Dilation
            Morphological_Dilation --> Sequential_Inpainting
        end

        Detailed_Generation_Control -- Inpainted Image, Controlled Generation Parameters --> Matrix_based_Generation

        Matrix_based_Generation["Matrix-based Generation"] --> Generated_Schemes_Display

        Generated_Schemes_Display["Generated Schemes Display"] -- Selected Scheme, Local Requirements/Constraints, Anchors/Arrowheads --> Local_Modification_Editing

        subgraph Local_Modification_Editing["Local Modification & Editing"]
            ControlNet_Inpaint_Model["ControlNet Inpaint Model"]
            DragDiffusion["DragDiffusion"]
            ControlNet_Inpaint_Model -- Local Regeneration --> DragDiffusion

MOD_Proximity_Detect_83f82b.name: Proximity_Detect
MOD_Proximity_Detect_83f82b.function: Determines if the user's hands are sufficiently close for an on-body touch interaction to occur (within 3 palm lengths). It then identifies 'active fingers' that are pointing outwards and not tucked in, passing them to the next stage.
MOD_Proximity_Detect_83f82b.source: EgoTouch: On-Body Touch Input Using AR/VR Headset Cameras
MOD_Proximity_Detect_83f82b._embed_content:
Name: Proximity_Detect
Role: processing_core:decision_logic
Function: Determines if the user's hands are sufficiently close for an on-body touch interaction to occur (within 3 palm lengths). It then identifies 'active fingers' that are pointing outwards and not tucked in, passing them to the next stage.
Input: 3D keypoints of hands
Output: Potentially active fingers

MOD_Norm_Patch_Extract_187474.name: Norm_Patch_Extract
MOD_Norm_Patch_Extract_187474.function: For each identified active finger, this module rotates and scales the camera image to align the finger vertically. It then extracts a 4x4 cm (100x100 px) patch centered at the fingertip, enabling multi-touch tracking.
MOD_Norm_Patch_Extract_187474.source: EgoTouch: On-Body Touch Input Using AR/VR Headset Cameras
MOD_Norm_Patch_Extract_187474._embed_content:
Name: Norm_Patch_Extract
Role: processing_core:feature_extraction
Function: For each identified active finger, this module rotates and scales the camera image to align the finger vertically. It then extracts a 4x4 cm (100x100 px) patch centered at the fingertip, enabling multi-touch tracking.
Input: Active fingers, 3D joint data
Output: Normalized finger patches (for each active finger)

MOD_Touch_Force_Model_bc745c.name: Touch_Force_Model
MOD_Touch_Force_Model_bc745c.function: Processes the normalized finger patches to predict whether a touch is occurring and to estimate the press force. This is done in parallel for all active fingers.
MOD_Touch_Force_Model_bc745c.source: EgoTouch: On-Body Touch Input Using AR/VR Headset Cameras
MOD_Touch_Force_Model_bc745c._embed_content:
Name: Touch_Force_Model
Role: processing_core:state_assessment
Function: Processes the normalized finger patches to predict whether a touch is occurring and to estimate the press force. This is done in parallel for all active fingers.
Input: Normalized finger patches
Output: Touch prediction (binary), press force estimate

MOD_Touch_State_Machine_4667dc.name: Touch_State_Machine
MOD_Touch_State_Machine_4667dc.function: Converts frame-by-frame touch predictions and force estimates into conventional touch-down and touch-up events. It also integrates 3D keypoint data to provide rich input metadata such as finger identification, 3D finger angle, and rotation.
MOD_Touch_State_Machine_4667dc.source: EgoTouch: On-Body Touch Input Using AR/VR Headset Cameras
MOD_Touch_State_Machine_4667dc._embed_content:
Name: Touch_State_Machine
Role: processing_core:decision_logic
Function: Converts frame-by-frame touch predictions and force estimates into conventional touch-down and touch-up events. It also integrates 3D keypoint data to provide rich input metadata such as finger identification, 3D finger angle, and rotation.
Input: Touch prediction, press force estimate, 3D keypoint data
Output: Touch-down/touch-up events, rich input metadata (touch force, finger identification, 3D finger angle, rotation)

MOD_End_User_Apps_778ec7.name: End_User_Apps
MOD_End_User_Apps_778ec7.function: Receives processed touch events and rich metadata from the EgoTouch system to enable interactive control and responses within AR/VR applications.
MOD_End_User_Apps_778ec7.source: EgoTouch: On-Body Touch Input Using AR/VR Headset Cameras
MOD_End_User_Apps_778ec7._embed_content:
Name: End_User_Apps
Role: interface_output:gui_display
Function: Receives processed touch events and rich metadata from the EgoTouch system to enable interactive control and responses within AR/VR applications.
Input: Touch events, rich metadata
Output: Application control/response

MOD_DSS_Input_d31e13.name: DSS_Input
MOD_DSS_Input_d31e13.function: Represents the input data point 'x' and the advice 'y' generated by an external Decision Support System (DSS). These are the primary inputs to the Interpretable Confidence Measure (ICM) framework.
MOD_DSS_Input_d31e13._embed_content:
Name: DSS_Input
Role: sensing_input:direct_input
Function: Represents the input data point 'x' and the advice 'y' generated by an external Decision Support System (DSS). These are the primary inputs to the Interpretable Confidence Measure (ICM) framework.
Input: NONE
Output: Data Point x, Advice y

MOD_Ground_Truth_Label_3fd3f7.name: Ground_Truth_Label
MOD_Ground_Truth_Label_3fd3f7.function: Represents the ground truth or true label 'y*' associated with a data point 'x'. This information is crucial for updating the memory of past cases, allowing the system to learn from actual outcomes.
MOD_Ground_Truth_Label_3fd3f7._embed_content:
Name: Ground_Truth_Label
Role: sensing_input:data_import
Function: Represents the ground truth or true label 'y*' associated with a data point 'x'. This information is crucial for updating the memory of past cases, allowing the system to learn from actual outcomes.
Input: NONE
Output: Ground Truth / Label y*

MOD_Update_Step_1c59b5.name: Update_Step
MOD_Update_Step_1c59b5.function: Continuously updates the memory 'D' with new data-label pairs '(x, y*)'. This step ensures that the memory adapts to changes in the DSS over time, maintaining a fixed size 'n' for 'D'.
MOD_Update_Step_1c59b5._embed_content:
Name: Update_Step
Role: processing_core:decision_logic
Function: Continuously updates the memory 'D' with new data-label pairs '(x, y*)'. This step ensures that the memory adapts to changes in the DSS over time, maintaining a fixed size 'n' for 'D'.
Input: (x, y*) (new data-label pair), Memory D (current state)
Output: Memory D (updated)

MOD_Memory_D_2e1831.name: Memory_D
MOD_Memory_D_2e1831.function: Stores a set of past cases 'D = {(x1, y*1), ..., (xn, y*n)}'. This memory serves as the historical data from which the confidence value is computed, continuously updated by the 'Update Step'.
MOD_Memory_D_2e1831._embed_content:
Name: Memory_D
Role: infrastructure:data_storage
Function: Stores a set of past cases 'D = {(x1, y*1), ..., (xn, y*n)}'. This memory serves as the historical data from which the confidence value is computed, continuously updated by the 'Update Step'.
Input: Memory D (updated from Update_Step)
Output: Memory D (for Selection_Step)

MOD_Selection_Step_7f8308.name: Selection_Step
MOD_Selection_Step_7f8308.function: Samples a subset 'S' from 'Memory D' that contains all relevant data-label pairs for defining the ICM's confidence value for the current data point 'x' and advice 'y'.
MOD_Selection_Step_7f8308._embed_content:
Name: Selection_Step
Role: processing_core:feature_extraction
Function: Samples a subset 'S' from 'Memory D' that contains all relevant data-label pairs for defining the ICM's confidence value for the current data point 'x' and advice 'y'.
Input: Memory D, Data Point x
Output: Set S

MOD_Separation_Step_986640.name: Separation_Step
MOD_Separation_Step_986640.function: Splits the selected set 'S' into two subsets: 'S+' and 'S-'. 'S+' contains data points where the past advice 'y*' was similar to the current advice 'y' and correct. 'S-' contains data points where the past advice 'y*' was different from 'y' or incorrect.
MOD_Separation_Step_986640._embed_content:
Name: Separation_Step
Role: processing_core:decision_logic
Function: Splits the selected set 'S' into two subsets: 'S+' and 'S-'. 'S+' contains data points where the past advice 'y*' was similar to the current advice 'y' and correct. 'S-' contains data points where the past advice 'y*' was different from 'y' or incorrect.
Input: Set S, Data Point x, Advice y
Output: S+, S-

MOD_Computation_Step_83dc3e.name: Computation_Step
MOD_Computation_Step_83dc3e.function: Calculates the final confidence value 'C(x)' for the current advice. This calculation is based on the separated sets 'S+' and 'S-' and a defined weighting scheme.
MOD_Computation_Step_83dc3e._embed_content:
Name: Computation_Step
Role: processing_core:content_generation
Function: Calculates the final confidence value 'C(x)' for the current advice. This calculation is based on the separated sets 'S+' and 'S-' and a defined weighting scheme.
Input: S+, S-
Output: Confidence Value C(x)

MOD_ICM_Output_6c1f5c.name: ICM_Output
MOD_ICM_Output_6c1f5c.function: Presents the calculated confidence value 'C(x)' to the user. This output aims to provide transparency and explainability regarding the DSS's advice.
MOD_ICM_Output_6c1f5c._embed_content:
Name: ICM_Output
Role: interface_output:gui_display
Function: Presents the calculated confidence value 'C(x)' to the user. This output aims to provide transparency and explainability regarding the DSS's advice.
Input: Confidence Value C(x)
Output: NONE
